title: docs: add Publish an Agent guide
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds the Publish an Agent integration guide
- Documents the one-step agent and callable-listing flow
- Keeps Community Agents API operations under Resources
- Updates account, CLI, README, drawer, and generated-doc source text
- Leaves `APIDOCS.md` untouched

Tests: gen docs routes, 7/7 passed.

Merge after #13624 and #13610.

gist.headline: Agents, Ready to Bloom
gist.blurb: A new guide walks builders from an agent idea to a published callable listing without making them excavate the API garden. Community Agent operations remain neatly planted under Resources.
gist.summary: Added the Publish an Agent integration guide, documenting the one-step agent and callable-listing flow while linking the updated account, CLI, README, drawer, and generated-doc routes.
gist.impact: Builders now have a single practical path for publishing an agent, with Community Agents API operations still easy to find under Resources.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli helping a small agent seedling become a labeled, callable garden listing on a cozy retro terminal. Use a clear one-step path from a tiny bot-in-a-pot to a blooming directory sign, with a documentation booklet and code-plants representing the guide; the monitor robot can eagerly point at the published listing.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-dark-brown striped bee mascot with black antennae, oval black eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blush, a happy smile, rounded translucent light-blue wings, and a tiny librarian scarf, placing a small friendly agent bot seedling into a blooming callable-listing garden beside a retro terminal; a cute CRT monitor robot points excitedly at a pixel sign reading “PUBLISH AGENT.” Lime green (#ecf874) is prominent among warm cream, mint, lavender, and peach code-plants and guide pages, cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
